invariants: Same current-frame geometry and material coverage

decision: Require every ON window to pass coverage/current-frame/energy gates. Derive CPU and GPU tolerances from repeated OFF windows; claim a saving only if its interval excludes zero. Do not sum rank 2 and rank 3 estimates into presented-frame savings.
